scope: aggregates were pelleted by centrifugation at 16,000 g for 10 min. Supernatants were removed and pellets washed 2x and resuspended in MgCl2- and CaCl2- free DPBS (ThermoFisher), then flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at −80°C before further processing and analysis by the Johns Hopkins Mass Spectrometry and Proteomics core facility. Pellets were reduced/alkylated with DTT/IAA, reconstituted in TEAB/acetonitrile, and sonicated for 15 min prior to overnight digestion with Trypsin/LysC (Promega, Madison, WI) at 37°C. Some precipitate remained; supernatants were desalted and analyzed by LC/MS/MS
